name: What should I look for in a real estate market report to understand property values?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a real estate market report to understand property values?

acceptedAnswer.text: To understand property values, look for key indicators like median sales price, price per square foot, and year-over-year appreciation rates. It's also important to examine days on market, which can indicate how quickly properties are selling. When evaluating a report, focus on data specific to your property type and local area, rather than broad county averages. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution advises clients to pay attention to trends in comparable properties to ensure a realistic assessment of value in their specific market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Focus on median sales price, price per square foot, appreciation rates, and days on market, specifically for your property type and local area.
